summary_1line: At Saunaka’s sacrifice, Sauti prepares to recount ancient tales and begins the genealogy of Bhrigu leading to the story of the demon Puloma and Bhrigu’s wife.

image_candidates.scene_text: In the forest of Naimisha, Sauti stands before an assembly of sages at a great sacrificial fire, hands joined as he prepares to speak.
The demon Puloma seizes the pregnant wife of the sage Bhrigu and carries her away from the hermitage in the forest.
